npcs.npcs.wayne.talk[0].lines[0]: Wayne: Things have been off all day. Doors banging, dust moving on its own.
npcs.npcs.wayne.talk[0].lines[1]: Want to know where to start?
npcs.npcs.wayne.talk[0].choices[1].reply: The empty mobiles are the worst. Something's nested in them.
Clear one out and the dust settles. For a while, anyway.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[0].lines[0]: Mrs Kehoe: My peg bag! You went into 131 for it? Good on you.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[0].lines[1]: Take a sausage off the barbecue. And this string, you'll find a use for it.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[1].lines[0]: Mrs Kehoe: Mind yourself out there.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[2].lines[0]: Mrs Kehoe: The wind took my peg bag in through the window of 131.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[2].lines[1]: Nobody's lived there since the Furlongs left. It's crawling with dust bunnies now.
npcs.npcs.kehoe.talk[2].lines[2]: Get it back and I'll see you right.
npcs.npcs.doyle.talk[0].lines[0]: Mr Doyle: The tide's well out tonight. You could walk to the Rock.
npcs.npcs.doyle.talk[1].lines[0]: Mr Doyle: The sea goes out a long way after dark.
npcs.npcs.doyle.talk[1].lines[2]: Watch for the sandbar off the North Strand.
npcs.npcs.shauna.talk[0].lines[1]: Here, take Deco's batteries. He won't miss them.
npcs.npcs.shauna.talk[1].lines[0]: Shauna: Go on, we're grand here.
npcs.npcs.shauna.talk[2].lines[0]: Shauna: This is our den. What do you want?
npcs.npcs.shauna.talk[2].lines[1]: Batteries? Bring us a Club Orange from Tony's van and they're yours.
npcs.npcs.shauna.talk[2].lines[2]: The van's down by the pitch.
npcs.npcs.aoife.talk[0].lines[0]: Aoife: Keep the deck. It needs wheels. There's an old pram behind 210.
npcs.npcs.aoife.talk[1].lines[0]: Aoife: Nobody beats me on the swings.
npcs.npcs.aoife.talk[1].lines[1]: Beat me and you can have my old skateboard deck.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[0].lines[0]: Nana Breda: Where did you find this?
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[0].lines[1]: Summer 1987. That's my Tom with the fishing rod.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[0].lines[3]: Keep the rod, love. He'd want it used.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[0].lines[4]: And take a slice of tart for the road.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[1].lines[0]: Nana Breda: Go on down to the bonfire. I'll watch from the step.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[2].lines[1]: I lost my photo album years ago, down in the clubhouse cellar.
npcs.npcs.nana.talk[2].lines[2]: Nobody goes down there now. Something lives in the dark.
npcs.npcs.mick.talk[0].lines[0]: Big Mick: Look after that BMX.
npcs.npcs.mick.talk[1].lines[0]: Big Mick: Ten keepy-uppies and the BMX is yours.
npcs.npcs.tony.talk[0].lines[0]: Tony: Tony's Ices. What'll it be?
npcs.npcs.biscuit.talk[0].lines[0]: Biscuit takes the sausage and trots off.
npcs.npcs.biscuit.talk[0].lines[1]: He was lying on a golf ball.
npcs.npcs.biscuit.talk[2].lines[0]: Biscuit the dog is lying on something and won't budge.
npcs.npcs.sully.talk[0].lines[1]: Take the torch. Mind the cellar under the clubhouse; there's eyes down there.
npcs.npcs.sully.talk[2].lines[0]: Sully: Three of my golf balls are gone.
npcs.npcs.sully.talk[2].lines[1]: Bring them back and I'll give you my torch.
npcs.npcs.tadhg.talk[1].lines[0]: Tadhg: Members only. Unless you know the word.
npcs.npcs.tadhg.talk[1].choices[0].reply: Tadhg: Right so. In you go.
npcs.npcs.roisin.talk[0].lines[1]: Take my spare fins. You'll get across the shallows with them.
npcs.npcs.roisin.talk[1].lines[0]: Róisín: Big Gerry has the flag out on the Rock. At low tide you can reach it.
npcs.npcs.roisin.talk[2].lines[0]: Róisín: Stay off the Rock. The gulls are vicious this year.
npcs.npcs.roisin.talk[2].lines[1]: I'd do anything for a 99. Tony brings the van down at dusk.
npcs.npcs.sandy1.talk[0].lines[0]: Sandy Acres kid: You got the flag back off Big Gerry. Fair play.
npcs.npcs.sandy1.talk[1].lines[0]: Sandy Acres kid: Your flag's out on the Rock.
npcs.npcs.sandy1.talk[1].lines[1]: Big Gerry took it. Biggest gull in Wexford.
npcs.npcs.sandy2.talk[0].lines[0]: Sandy Acres kid: Beat our challenge first.
npcs.npcs.quizmaster.talk[0].lines[0]: Father Murphy: Final round coming up.
npcs.npcs.mam.talk[0].lines[0]: Mam: Is that the Tara Glen flag? Off the Rock?
npcs.npcs.mam.talk[0].lines[1]: Dad: Well done. Nobody's got it back in years.
npcs.npcs.mam.talk[0].lines[4]: Mam: Come here and sit with us. Best summer yet.
npcs.npcs.mam.talk[1].lines[0]: Mam: There you are. Come sit by the fire.
npcs.npcs.mam.talk[2].lines[0]: Mam: What are you doing here? You're meant to be in the mobile!
story.entities[0].text[0]: A note from Mam on the table:
story.entities[0].text[1]: 'Gone to the clubhouse quiz. Stay in the mobile.'
story.entities[1].text[0]: Out the window: the Top Field, quiet. Too quiet.
story.entities[1].text[1]: A peg bag blows past. Then a cloud of dust that moves against the wind.
story.entities[5].text[1]: '...kkhh... the dust is moving... stay inside...'
story.entities[7].locked: A tap. You've nothing to fill.
story.entities[11].text[0]: Trainers with grippy soles. You could climb a gate in these.
story.entities[13].text[0]: An old pram behind 210. You take the wheels.
story.entities[16].text[0]: A golf ball. Biscuit was lying on it.
story.entities[18].text[0]: A golf ball in the rough. SULLY written on it.
story.entities[23].locked: Stairs down to the cellar. Pitch black. Something blinks down there.
story.entities[24].text[0]: Under a pile of bunting: a photo album. 'Tara Glen, Summer 1987'.
story.entities[26].text[0]: You cast Grandad's rod and hook the lifeguard's key off the whitethorn.
story.entities[26].locked: A key hangs off a whitethorn branch over the ditch. Out of reach.
story.entities[30].text[0]: Big Gerry drops the flag and flies off.
story.entities[32].text[0]: From the top of the climbing frame the whole park is orange.
story.entities[32].text[1]: The lamps are coming on. The sea has gone out further than you've ever seen.
story.locks[0].text: A tall locked gate. You'd need grippy shoes to climb it.
story.locks[1].text: ROAD CLOSED. The pole is too low to duck under. You'd need to slide under it on a board.
story.locks[2].text: A cattle grid. You'd need wheels.
story.locks[3].text: The beach gate. Padlocked. 'KEY HELD BY LIFEGUARD'.
story.locks[4].text: The groyne runs out into deep water. Wait for the tide.
story.locks[5].text: A channel between the sandbar and the Rock. Too deep without fins.
story.events[0].effects[0].say[0]: The walkie crackles: '...the clubhouse password tonight is SPUDS...'
story.events[1].effects[0].say[0]: The sun drops behind the clubhouse. The lamps come on.
story.events[1].effects[0].say[1]: Down on the strand the tide is going a long way out.
story.events[1].effects[0].say[2]: Someone's lit a bonfire on the beach.
story.hints[0].tiers[0]: Fill your balloons: combine the bucket with the pack.
story.hints[0].tiers[1]: Open your bag 🎒 and combine the balloons with the bucket.
story.hints[0].tiers[2]: 🎒 → 'Pack of balloons', then 'Bucket of water'. The bucket's in the bathroom.
story.hints[1].tiers[0]: Get Mrs Kehoe's peg bag back from 131.
story.hints[1].tiers[1]: 131 is just south-west of 127. Clear the dust bunnies inside.
story.hints[1].tiers[2]: Clear 131. The chest in the back room has trainers.
story.hints[2].tiers[0]: Climb the tall gate into Playground Row.
story.hints[2].tiers[1]: The tall gate is at the bottom of the long hedge, east side.
story.hints[2].tiers[2]: Walk into the tall gate wearing the trainers.
story.hints[3].tiers[0]: Build a skateboard: Aoife's deck and some wheels.
story.hints[3].tiers[1]: Win the swing game, then check behind Nana Breda's mobile (210).
story.hints[3].tiers[2]: Combine the deck and the pram wheels in your bag 🎒.
story.hints[4].tiers[0]: Slide under the ROAD CLOSED pole.
story.hints[4].tiers[1]: Dodge under the pole on the main road south with the skateboard.
story.hints[4].tiers[2]: Face the pole and dodge right in front of it.
story.hints[5].tiers[0]: Win Big Mick's BMX on the pitch.
story.hints[5].tiers[1]: Do ten keepy-uppies for Big Mick.
story.hints[5].tiers[2]: Talk to Big Mick in the middle of the pitch.
story.hints[6].tiers[1]: The teens in the woods den want a Club Orange from Tony's van.
story.hints[6].tiers[2]: Buy a can from Tony (2🪙), give it to Shauna in the den north-west of 127, then combine walkie + batteries.
story.hints[7].tiers[0]: Cross the cattle grid south of the pitch.
story.hints[7].tiers[1]: Ride the bike 🚲 over the cattle grid.
story.hints[7].tiers[2]: Get on the bike and ride straight over it.
story.hints[8].tiers[1]: One's under Biscuit, one's at crazy golf, one's on the links.
story.hints[8].tiers[2]: Feed Biscuit the sausage, win crazy golf, find the ball on the far links, give all 3 to Sully.
story.hints[9].tiers[1]: The teens let the password slip on the walkie.
story.hints[9].tiers[2]: Fix the walkie, then tell Tadhg the password.
story.hints[10].tiers[0]: Find Nana Breda's album in the clubhouse cellar.
story.hints[10].tiers[1]: The cellar stairs are behind the bar. You need light.
story.hints[10].tiers[2]: With the torch, go through the bar to the cellar stairs.
story.hints[11].tiers[0]: Bring the album to Nana Breda.
story.hints[11].tiers[1]: Nana Breda lives at 210 on Playground Row.
story.hints[11].tiers[2]: Talk to Nana Breda with the album.
story.hints[12].tiers[0]: Hook the key over the ditch by the beach gate.
story.hints[12].tiers[1]: Use the fishing rod by the ditch next to the beach gate.
story.hints[12].tiers[2]: Stand by the whitethorn near the beach gate and press Action.
story.hints[13].tiers[0]: Get fins from Róisín the lifeguard.
story.hints[13].tiers[1]: Tony's van comes down to the beach at dusk. A 99 is 3🪙.
story.hints[13].tiers[2]: Give Róisín a 99 for her spare fins.
story.hints[14].tiers[0]: Take the flag back from Big Gerry on the Rock.
story.hints[14].tiers[1]: Go round the groyne, out the sandbar, and wade the channel with fins.
story.hints[14].tiers[2]: North Strand → sandbar → the Rock. Dodge his dives, hit him when he lands.
story.hints[15].tiers[0]: Take the flag to the bonfire.
story.hints[15].tiers[1]: Mam and Dad are at the bonfire on the South Strand.
story.hints[15].tiers[2]: Talk to Mam at the bonfire.
world.strings.lose: Not quite. Tap to try again
world.strings.fainted: You're knocked down. Back to the checkpoint.
world.strings.huntFail: Out of time. Talk to the kids to try again.
items.items.balloons.desc: Secondary attack: throw with the small 🎈 button. Refill at taps.
items.items.skateboard.desc: Dodge further and slide under barriers.
items.items.bike.desc: Tap 🚲 to ride. Crosses cattle grids.
items.items.can.desc: A cold can of Club Orange.
items.recipes[1].text: Wheels on the deck. A skateboard.
rooms.procedural.secretLocks[0].text: Pitch black. You need a torch.
rooms.procedural.secretLocks[1].text: A low gap under a wardrobe. You could slide through on a board.
